中国科学院院士、大湾区大学创校校长田刚介绍：“智能计算专业紧扣国家战略、科技前沿: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and founding president of the Greater Bay Area University Tian Gang introduced: 'The Intelligent Computing major closely aligns with national strategy, scientific and technological frontiers, and the industrial needs of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area, aiming to cultivate composite talent capable of understanding AI, improving AI, and using AI to solve scientific and industrial problems.'
”有人说，未来是“人机分工时代”，当AI能做的事越来越多，大学应如何培养人才: 'Some say the future is an 'era of human-machine division of labor.' When AI can do increasingly more tasks, how should universities cultivate talent?
高校新增AI相关专业和课程，正是在回应知识结构和人才结构发生的深层变化: Higher education institutions adding AI-related majors and courses are precisely responding to deep-level changes in knowledge structure and talent structure.
更重要的是，AI时代变化很快，没有哪一门课程可以覆盖未来所有技术: More importantly, the AI era changes rapidly, and no single course can cover all future technologies.
城乡之间，AI在缩小教学差距，还是加深鸿沟: Between urban and rural areas, is AI narrowing the teaching gap or deepening the divide?
近年来，乡村学校硬件设施大幅提升，AI把优质课程、名师资源送到偏远地区，一定程度: In recent years, hardware facilities at rural schools have improved significantly. AI brings high-quality courses and resources from renowned teachers to remote areas, narrowing the gap in educational resources to a certain extent.
面对日新月异的AI技术，部分乡村学校在课程开发、教学理念转变等方面仍有欠缺，是否: Facing ever-changing AI technology, some rural schools still have shortcomings in curriculum development and the transformation of teaching concepts. Will this deepen the new divide between those who 'can use AI' and those who 'cannot use AI'?
黄荣怀：AI时代的教育公平，正在从“能否接入”进一步延伸到“能否有效使用”: Huang Ronghuai: Educational equity in the AI era is further extending from 'whether one can access' to 'whether one can use effectively.'
即使拥有相同的技术接入条件，不同学校、教师、学生和家庭由于AI素养、应用方式和支: Even with identical technological access conditions, different schools, teachers, students, and families may produce vastly different effects due to differences in AI literacy, application methods, and support conditions.
现阶段发展AI+教育，乡村学校所面临的并非单一技术问题，而是多重系统性问题: At the present stage, developing AI+Education, the problems rural schools face are not merely technical issues, but multiple systemic problems.
老师从“会用”到“善用”之间仍存在差距，AI教学仍较多停留在课件生成、作业批改、: There remains a gap between teachers 'being able to use' and 'using well.' AI teaching still largely remains at shallow scenarios such as courseware generation, homework grading, and simple answering of questions, with insufficient continuous training and teaching research.
发展AI+教育，乡村需要系统支撑：资源调配上，推动优质资源持续下沉和开放共享: To develop AI+Education, rural areas need systemic support: in resource allocation, promote the continuous flow and open sharing of quality resources.
依托国家中小学智慧教育平台，支持农村和边远地区学校开好信息科技与人工智能相关课程: Relying on the National Smart Education Platform for Primary and Secondary Schools, support rural and remote area schools in offering information technology and artificial intelligence-related courses, and through methods such as sending teaching to rural areas, renowned teacher workshops, and regional teaching research communities, continue to deliver quality teachers and mature teaching cases to rural schools.
协同育人上，联动学校、家庭、村委会与综合文化站等，引导学生正确使用AI、理性认识: In collaborative education, coordinate schools, families, village committees, and comprehensive cultural centers to guide students in using AI correctly, understanding AI rationally, and independently commanding AI, avoiding the formation of new capability and thinking divides.
AI生成的内容大多是通用的、城市视角的，但乡村教师熟悉孩子们的家庭情况、性格特点: AI-generated content is mostly generic and urban-centric, but rural teachers are familiar with students' family situations, personality characteristics, and knowledge gaps. They can connect textbook knowledge with children's lives and teach in a way that is more grounded.
我想，当AI走进乡村课堂，人与人的真实连接会变得更加重要: I believe that when AI enters rural classrooms, authentic human connection will become even more important.
数据泄露、算法偏见，AI教育产品的风险监管如何加强: Data breaches and algorithmic bias: How can risk regulation of AI educational products be strengthened?
有媒体报道，山东济南市民张女士花近5000元，为孩子购入一款AI学习机，注册登录: Some media reports indicate that Zhang, a citizen of Jinan, Shandong, spent nearly 5,000 yuan to purchase an AI learning machine for her child. When registering and logging in, she only checked basic usage permissions and did not carefully read the privacy policy spanning tens of thousands of characters.
很多AI教育产品都有“情绪识别”“专注度分析”等功能，这些产品及其功能的边界在哪: Many AI educational products feature functions such as 'emotion recognition' and 'focus analysis.' What are the boundaries of these products and their functions, and how should they be regulated?
黄荣怀：目前部分AI教育产品在助力个性化、精准化的同时，也可能带来错误或虚假信息: Huang Ronghuai: Currently, while some AI educational products assist in personalization and precision, they may also bring new problems such as the spread of incorrect or false information, privacy and data breaches, and algorithmic bias and discrimination.
随着AI与教育深度融合，亟须形成政府统筹、学校规范、企业履责、家庭参与、社会协同: As AI and education deepen their integration, there is an urgent need to form a pluralistic co-governance pattern involving government coordination, school regulation, corporate accountability, family participation, and social cooperation.
一要完善AI教育应用标准与实践指南，健全技术标准、质量标准与伦理规范，强化数据采: First, improve standards and practical guidelines for AI educational applications, improve technical standards, quality standards, and ethical norms, and strengthen institutionalized management throughout the entire process of data collection, storage, and usage.
四要提升学校与家庭风险防范能力，明确使用边界，加强教师对AI生成内容的审核，培养: Fourth, enhance schools' and families' risk prevention capabilities, clarify usage boundaries, strengthen teachers' review of AI-generated content, cultivate students' information discrimination and responsible usage abilities, and encourage families to pay attention to data collection and exercise prudent authorization, jointly safeguarding the digital rights of minors.
